headline: NFL Week 7 Thursday: Bears edge Patriots 30-24 at Soldier Field
whyCareReason: Caleb Williams passed for 308 yards and 2 touchdowns. Cairo Santos drilled a 58-yard field goal to seal the win.
teaser: FINAL: Bears 30, Patriots 24. Williams 308 yds, 2 TD; Burden 130 rec yds. Bears 5-2, Patriots 4-3.
story: The Chicago Bears held off a furious New England Patriots fourth-quarter charge to secure a 30-24 victory on Thursday Night Football at Soldier Field. Caleb Williams completed 22 of 33 passes for 308 yards and two touchdowns, finishing with a 116.7 passer rating. Rookie receiver Luther Burden III had a breakout performance with four catches for 130 yards and a score in the first half, while D'Andre Swift rushed for 78 yards and a touchdown. Cairo Santos drilled a franchise record-tying 58-yard field goal with 1:34 remaining to put the game out of reach. Drake Maye threw for 321 yards and two touchdowns with one interception for New England. The Bears improve to 5-2, while the Patriots drop to 4-3.
stakes: Chicago moves to 5-2 in the competitive NFC playoff race, while New England slips to 4-3 in the AFC East.
rivalryAngle: A classic interconference battle comes down to the final two minutes at Soldier Field.
